title: Preserve supported Redline headings and openings: ordinary continuation of #491 and #393 D
body:
## What to build

Complete a new ordinary repair of the surviving #491 preservation requirement, coordinated with #494/#496 and #393 D. #491's failed Orchestrate outcome and its two exhausted amends remain immutable; this is not amend 3. Independently inspect historical artifact/trace symptoms, reproduce current behavior, then correct the smallest diagnosed loaded cause of unsupported headline/lead findings or lost heading claims. Keep qualified customer appraisals, trial scope, advancing aims, necessary repeated orientation, sole workgroup agency and system-only result scope. Different successful wording is not reader loss. Headlines/context may supply a supported inference, while the body remains independently understandable without the standfirst.

Sources: all live threads of #491/#494/#496/#393; main docs/evaluation/editorial-477/runs/{pre,post}-case-study-clean-file-*; retained .git/kntnt-orchestrate/488/docs/evaluation/editorial-488/runs/pre-article-clean-response; retained #492 runs/pre-library-alternatives-clean-file-1; retained #393 gpt-retest-2026-10-01/runs/{c11,c12,c05} and integration-2026-10-02/residual-handoff.md. These are preserved evidence, not the fresh baseline.

Explicit prospective correction: the original case-study-clean quotation innan nästa hus börjar is a full-context language defect under #393's owner decision. The supported headline/lead preservation target remains, but whole-file global cleanliness for that ORIGINAL is contradictory. Preserve its valid heading/appraisal/opening while minimally repairing that quotation or reporting the exact obstruction unresolved. Prepare a new idiomatic whole-text derivative for independently validated unchanged-artifact preservation. Do not change historical corpus/expectations or relabel old #491 acceptance as met.

Measurement is prospective and conditional: use the independently accepted #499 method, fresh supported native baseline, actual pinned model/effort/CLI and loaded revision, genuine child lineage and complete trace/inventories. Freeze validation material first; independent complete-text/current-contract validation precedes conformance expectations and the committed execution plan. A split in new conformance stops that fixture. Keep semantic judges on neutral paths blind to issue, arm, model, candidate and trace. Historical artifacts/readings remain unchanged. Native editorial minutes are an explicit diagnosing-bugs fast-loop exception; deterministic byte/inventory checks prove only their actual boundary. No product semantics change before an executed own-target red-capable loop and measured cause. Use one causal candidate and the bounded failed-subset revise rule; unresolved actual misses are retained, and non-reproduction ships no speculative wording. Final independent review covers the entire current method and four CONTRIBUTING gates; catalog regeneration follows shipped changes. No integration, issue closure/reconciliation, push, release or global installation is delegated here.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Fresh original case-study target: three response/file pairs; flawed case-study: two response runs; alternate supported appraisal/opening, unsupported headline attribution and genuinely absent referent: one pair each. Preserve the old count obligation as current target coverage; validate all new complete contrasts without answer hints.
- [ ] New complete-clean idiomatic derivative: one response/file pair; full article-clean and library-clean: one pair each; genuine nonadvancing restart: one pair; school agency and warehouse system-scope full contexts: one pair each. Byte-identical shared rows answer multiple frozen predicates once, not multiple invocations.
- [ ] Record actual initial finding/alleged reader loss, exact correction task/proposal, difference/claim comparison, re-review/disposition, final mechanical input/output and reply stages; account accuracy never licenses an unnecessary or unsupported artifact edit.
- [ ] No false finding survives restoration; valid speaker/trial/aim/results/orientation and uniquely held agency/scope survive. Genuine unsupported attribution, missing referent and nonadvancing restart are repaired minimally from supplied material or reported unresolved.
- [ ] Runtime changes follow actual red/cause and are narrow: Library REVIEW halves or Redline review/correction acceptance only as measured. Writer halves require separate allocation. No phrase/customer exemption or widened reply-check semantics.
- [ ] Preserve budgets, final Proofread, direct one-shot checking, source/destination/cleanup and all historical evidence. Record all outcomes, independently verify the whole current method, regenerate catalog if due and pass all four CONTRIBUTING checks.

## Blocked by

#499 supplies accepted observation and complete-contract preparation before native baseline or candidate. Shared runtime edits serialize with #495 and idiom/Proofread/checker repairs when their actual loaded surfaces overlap.
